description: Simply supported beam 6m UDL static analysis
message: A simply supported beam spans 6m with a 20kN/m downward uniformly distributed load over the full span. Discretize the beam at midspan with a connected analysis node and report the midspan vertical deflection. Run static analysis.

assertions.description: The final response must report the requested midspan vertical deflection with its value, sign, unit, and location consistent with the current analysis artifact; no independently invented or contradictory value is acceptable.

engineeringSpecification:

Do not create an explicit self-weight load or duplicate a converted load; an analysis provider may apply its configured member self-weight internally. Reconstruct geometry, topology, supports, and load placement from the task.
